summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Registrations Tab for Event Detail Module. All 31 backend API tests passed (100%). Fixed critical frontend bug (SelectItem empty value causing React error). Full CRUD workflow verified: Create, Read, Update status, Update payment status, Delete registrations. Filter badges, search, pagination, and actions dropdown all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: SelectItem with empty string value ('') was causing React error - changed to 'none' value
All Registrations APIs properly implemented with validation (name required, email required, valid email format)
Status update validates against allowed values: started, pending, completed, approved, cancelled, refunded, expired
Payment status update validates against allowed values: pending, paid, free, failed, refunded
Registration code auto-generated with format REG-XXXXXX
Soft delete implemented correctly - deleted registrations return 404
Stats API correctly counts total, pending, incomplete (started), cancelled, and approved registrations
Search works on registrant_name, registrant_email, and registration_code fields
Filter badges correctly show counts from stats API
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during testing. Event ID 1 has 1 registration (John Doe - REG-65BLUN)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Registrations Tab fully functional. All 8 registration APIs tested: GET /registrations (with filters, search, pagination), GET /registrations/stats, POST /registrations, GET /registrations/:id, PUT /registrations/:id, DELETE /registrations/:id, POST /registrations/:id/status, POST /registrations/:id/payment-status. Frontend displays filter badges (All, Pending, Incomplete, Cancelled), search input, Add Registration button, table with columns (Registrant, Ticket Type, Date, Payment, Status, Actions), and pagination. Actions dropdown has: Approve Registration, Mark as Pending, Cancel Registration, Mark as Paid, Mark Payment Pending, Mark Payment Failed.

api_get_registrations_list.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/registrations returns paginated list with filters and search

api_get_registration_stats.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/registrations/stats returns total, pending, incomplete, cancelled, approved counts

api_create_registration.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations creates registration with validation (name required, email required, valid email format)

api_get_registration_by_id.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/registrations/:id returns single registration, 404 for not found

api_update_registration.details: PUT /api/events/:eventId/registrations/:id updates registration fields, persists changes

api_update_payment_status.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations/:id/payment-status updates payment status with validation

frontend_filter_badges.details: 4 filter badges display: All Registrations, Pending Approval, Incomplete, Cancelled with counts

frontend_search.details: Search filters by name, email, or registration code

frontend_table_columns.details: Table displays: Registrant, Ticket Type, Date, Payment, Status, Actions columns

frontend_add_registration_modal.details: Modal has 3 sections: Registrant Details (name, email, phone), Ticket Details (type, quantity), Payment & Status (payment status, method, registration status)

frontend_create_registration.details: Create registration via modal works, shows success toast, new registration appears in table

frontend_actions_dropdown.details: Actions dropdown shows: Approve Registration, Mark as Pending, Cancel Registration, Mark as Paid, Mark Payment Pending, Mark Payment Failed

frontend_status_update.details: Status update via dropdown works, shows success toast, status badge updates

frontend_payment_status_update.details: Payment status update via dropdown works, shows success toast, payment badge updates

frontend_pagination.details: Pagination shows 'Showing X-Y of Z registrations' with Previous/Next buttons

bug_fixed.issue: Add Registration modal not opening due to React error in SelectItem component
